commands.command: QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev .env DSN> cargo test -p quansio-server --test ops_kill_switches # kill-switch E2E through real turns, emergency deny, worker quarantine, drain/undrain, connector revoke, stream shed, provider outage drill against the real Python plane, runbook drift
cargo test -p quansio-server --lib ops # target shapes, the gate, the runbook catalog
uv run --project python pytest python/tests/intelligence/test_model_provider_disable.py -v # the gateway never routes to a disabled provider
cargo test -p quansio-machine # the target lifecycle with DRAINING -> READY
ops008_mutations.sh # compiling mutants across dispatch, the gate, machine side effects, the model source, the live hub and the Python gateway
QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev .env DSN> bash scripts/ci/ci.sh # binaries pinned via QUANSIO_TEST_SERVER_BIN/SEED_BIN
